citations.claim: first in_arena violation: body 0 centre x plus radius exceeds 20m arena width
one step before, body 0 still inside arena moving +x at ~30.6 m/s
body 0 acquired ~30.6 m/s +x velocity from body-body impact just before
one step earlier body 0 was stationary in x, showing impulsive launch

counterfactual.change: reduced body 1 initial vx from 27.7 to 10.0 (one field); lower impact speed gives lower ejecta speed so body 0 never reaches the right boundary within 33 steps

explanation: Heavy fast body 1 (m~4.91, vx~27.7) strikes stationary light body 0 around step 26-27, launching body 0 to vx~30.64. Body 0 then travels undisturbed to the right boundary (x 18.92 at step 32 to 19.45 at step 33) and the right boundary collision fails to reflect it, so its edge extends 0.25 beyond the 20m arena, violating in_arena. Lowering the impactor speed removes the fast ejecta and the escape.
vision_note: The red body travels rightward toward the arena boundary across steps 30-32 with the blue body trailing behind it. At step 33 the red body reaches the right wall and protrudes past the border instead of bouncing back inside.
